title: Designing Maintainable Next.js Project Structures
summary: How to separate UI, domain data, and types so a portfolio can scale into a full product.
content: This article explains a practical way to separate UI rendering, domain types, and content data in modern Next.js projects.
It covers tradeoffs in file organization and how to avoid coupling data definitions directly to section components.
The goal is to keep early-stage prototypes easy to evolve into production-grade systems.
